items.rationale: Fitting used to reconnect the failed heating pipe; covered as repair material under 7.1.7(c). Press fittings cost about 8-10 EUR each, 4 pcs.
Repair material for the failed pipe, but it is 28mm while the documented pipe is 15mm (invoiced copper pipe 15x1), so 7.1.8(e) may apply; if paid, 28mm elbows run about 18-20 EUR each.
Same 28mm dimension doubt under 7.1.8(e); if paid, about 18 EUR.
Minor fixings are covered under 7.1.7(c); small value.
Fixings for the repaired run are covered under 7.1.7(c); a 25mm clamp is close to the documented pipe size. About 5-6 EUR each.
Replacement pipe section for the failed heating pipe; covered. About 9-10 EUR/m for 6.4 m.
Labour is covered under 7.1.7(g), but part of the hours went on uninsured jobs (painting, laminate, garden tap), so some risk of reduction. Prior gives about 566 for the full 6.75 hrs.
Covered labour, but likely partly spent on the maintenance jobs; moderate rate of about 60/hr for 5.75 hrs.
Re-insulation matching the pre-loss installation is covered under 7.1.7(c); prior about 24 per pc for 6 pcs.
Consumable for fixing the insulation, covered under 7.1.7(c); 2 kg is generous.
A lump sum is not excluded per 7.1.8(e) last sentence; small amount.
One call-out charge per contractor per invoice is covered under 7.1.7(f); about 80.
Debris removal is covered under 5.2.1 and 7.1.8(a), though part of the waste likely came from the uninsured laminate job; about 55.

items.description: Repainting basement hallway outside boiler room
items.rationale: Area not affected by the escape of water; excluded by 3.5 and 7.1.5.
Room not affected by the leak; excluded by 7.1.5 and 7.1.8(a).
Maintenance unrelated to the damage; not a repair cost under 7.1.8(a).
Administrative charge excluded by 7.1.8(b); never paid in earlier cases.
